title: Assay Buffer for Hexokinase Activity and Radiochemical Filter Paper Assay Guide
author: Janne R. Hingst
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xckfiuw
materials: The filter paper dries in the fume hood.
Magnesium chloride | EMD Millipore | 1.05832 | 150 mM | 5 mM
Creatine Kinase | ROCHE | 12288520 | SA800 U/mg | 7 U/ml

steps.title: Prepare Sample Homogenate
steps.instruction: Dilute the homogenate to a concentration of 1-2 mg/ml using Homogenization Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Dilute heart and red muscles to lower concentrations than white muscles.

steps.title: Prepare 96-well PCR Plate
steps.instruction: Add 15 µl of sample into a 96-well PCR plate, keeping the plate in an aluminum plate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µl of homogenization buffer as a control to designated wells.
Add 15 µl of cold assay buffer (buffer without tracer) as a control to designated wells.
Add 15 µl of a standard pool to every assay for comparison across plates.

steps.title: Initiate Kinase Reaction
steps.instruction: Transfer the 96-well PCR plate to a new aluminum plate on a 30 °C heating block and start the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µl of assay buffer (containing [14C]-Glucose-2-deoxy-glucose at a final concentration of 2.4 µci/ml) to the designated wells using a multichannel pipette.
Do not add assay buffer to the cold assay buffer control wells.
Ensure the assay buffer reaches the bottom of the wells and is mixed appropriately with the homogenate.

steps.title: Stop Kinase Reaction
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction after 15-25 min at 30 °C (duration depends on tissue and µg protein) by adding 30 µl (1 vol) of 90% EtOH to all wells, including controls.

substeps.instruction: Ensure full mixture by manual agitation.

steps.title: Spot Samples on Filter Paper
steps.instruction: Spot 20 µl of the reaction mixture in duplicates onto DE81 filter paper using a multichannel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Spot assay buffer directly on the filter paper in volumes of 2x1 µl and 2x2 µl.
To determine specific activity, spot 3x3 µl and 3x6 µl into vials containing 4 mL UG scintillation liquid.

steps.title: Wash Filter Paper
steps.instruction: Wash the filter paper 3 times for 20 minutes each in excess 60% EtOH (e.g., 300 ml in a 31 cm x 22 cm x 6 cm box).

steps.title: Dry and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Allow the DE81 paper to dry completely, then cover it with plastic wrap and place it in a cassette.

steps.title: Analyze Activity
steps.instruction: Count the samples in a Phosphorimager after 48 hours and calculate the activity in µmol/g protein/min.
